category: inference gateway, invite-only beta, prepaid credits

free_tier.stated: None: access is invite-only during the private beta and every call draws on prepaid USD credits with a minimum purchase of USD 5. A first top-up of USD 10 or more earns a USD 5 bonus while the offer lasts, and an invite link can add sign-up credit up to the limit it shows.

tooling: OpenAI-compatible REST at https://api.fluence.cloud/v1 and an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint at https://api.fluence.cloud; one key with the inference permission
chaining: routes each request to one of several providers behind one key and one base URL; the invitation and the prepaid balance gate every call

limits.value: unpublished at account level; a key can carry its own per-minute and per-day request caps, a concurrency cap and a monthly USD budget set by its owner
minimum credit purchase USD 5; a first top-up of USD 10 or more earns a USD 5 bonus; HTTP 402 when available credit is insufficient

binding_note: access is by invitation and every call spends prepaid credit, so there is no free allowance to run out first

identity_cost.detail: an invitation to an email address is required during the private beta, sign-in is by one-time code or link, and credits are bought through Stripe checkout with a USD 5 minimum; other payment methods are not listed on the page read

confidence_note: documentation page only; the size of an invite-link credit is unverified
